text_en: Then he cried in my hearing with a loud voice, saying, “Draw near, you executioners of the city, each with his destroying weapon in his hand. ”
text_cn: 以后我听见他高声喊说：“惩罚此城的，快来！每人手中应拿着毁灭的工具。”

text_en: And six men came from the direction of the upper gate, which faces north, each with his weapon for slaughter in his hand; among them was a man clothed in linen, with a writing case at his side. They went in and stood beside the bronze altar.
text_cn: 看，有六个人从上边朝北的门走来，每人拿着破坏的武器。他们中间有一个人身穿细麻衣，腰间带着书记的墨盒。他们来到，就站在铜祭坛旁。

text_en: Now the glory of the God of Israel had gone up from the cherub on which it rested to the threshold of the house. The Lord called to the man clothed in linen, who had the writing case at his side;
text_cn: 那停在革鲁宾上的以色列的天主光荣，就由革鲁宾身上升起，来到圣殿的门限上，叫将那身穿细麻衣，腰间带着墨盒的人召来。

text_en: and said to him, “Go through the city, through Jerusalem, and put a mark on the foreheads of those who sigh and groan over all the abominations that are committed in it. ”
text_cn: 上主对他说：“你要走遍此城，即走遍耶路撒冷，凡因城中发生的丑恶之事而悲痛哀号的人，要在他们额上划一个十字记号。”

text_en: To the others he said in my hearing, “Pass through the city after him, and kill; your eye shall not spare, and you shall show no pity.
text_cn: 以后我听见他向其余的人说：“你们也跟着他走遍全城击杀，你们的眼不要怜视，一点也不要顾惜；

text_en: Cut down old men, young men and young women, little children and women, but touch no one who has the mark. And begin at my sanctuary. ” So they began with the elders who were in front of the house.
text_cn: 把老人、少年、处女、婴儿和妇女都要杀尽灭绝；但凡额上有十字记号的人，不可走近。你们从圣所这里开始。”果然他们就从在圣殿前的长老开始。

text_en: Then he said to them, “Defile the house, and fill the courts with the slain. Go! ” So they went out and killed in the city.
text_cn: 以后又向他们说：“你们要玷污这圣殿，使被杀者充塞整个庭院，然后出去！”他们就出去，在城中击杀。

text_en: While they were killing, and I was left alone, I fell prostrate on my face and cried out, “Ah Lord God ! will you destroy all who remain of Israel as you pour out your wrath upon Jerusalem? ”
text_cn: 他们去击杀时，只留下我一人。我就伏地掩面呼求说：“哎！吾主上主，你在耶路撒冷发泄你的愤怒，要灭绝以色列的遗民吗？”

text_en: He said to me, “The guilt of the house of Israel and Judah is exceedingly great; the land is full of bloodshed and the city full of perversity; for they say, ‘The Lord has forsaken the land, and the Lord does not see. ’
text_cn: 他回答我说：“以色列和犹大的家族，实在罪大恶极；此地充满了血债，满城都是暴行，他们还说：上主已离弃了此地，上主看不见。

text_en: As for me, my eye will not spare, nor will I have pity, but I will bring down their deeds upon their heads. ”
text_cn: 因此，我的眼也决不怜视，一点也不顾惜；反而我要把他们的行为，归在他们头上。”

text_en: Then the man clothed in linen, with the writing case at his side, brought back word, saying, “I have done as you commanded me. ”
text_cn: 看啊，那身穿细麻衣，腰间带着墨盒的人，回来报告说：“我已照你吩咐的做了。”
